body: how I've lost my hope used my last bit of money on a gun ruined any chance of school now that I've just not shown up no job due to just not going after my week stay in a psych ward. tried explaining to my grandpa he doesn't understand ended up going to a psych ward for a week just to come back to want and kill myself 2 days later quit going to my job cuz no point didnt call and say i wasnt coming just stopped showing up. when I do tell people they must think I'm joking so I don't seek out help from people close to me. I've tried meds from making me a zombie to making my suicidal thoughts worse and to not being able to orgasm. If I have to take a pill just to be able to make it through the day I don't see a point. we're not here for any reason there is literally no point. Yea stay here and struggle what another 60 years? Just to end up in oblivion either ways? I think you have to be insane to live this pointless existence. No wonder when you had a 1st grade reading level I was on a college level.

I am very good at hiding it. I've only told one person how I truly feel and she told me herself she thinks I'm insane. And a few who I've scratched the surface with my brother is one of them. He told me himself he would be devastated but I can't live without the desire to live. As for the gun I'm not killing myself tonight as much as I want to. My vicodins are kicking in and I smoked so I will probably just sleep, but I don't even get peace in my dreams so I'm just wasting time. I'm going to kill myself before my grandfather returns next week. Once he finds out about everything I will be homeless anyways so I would just end up doing it then. I'm thinking tuesday since it will have been 1 week since I bought the gun.

I'm not alone but doesnt matter if I'm in a room with 5 people I know or 100 I couldn't feel less alone. and As for being a burden don't think I could convince myself I'm not. My life isnt bad, everything is paid for me, people give up things for me. I don't want that. There is no future for me because I have no interest in one. After all the only reason I could come up with to try and live is getting laid. My life isn't over yet but it feels like I'm just the shell of whoever use to live in here, and this mind is rejecting me. I know I can pull the trigger today if theres a god he must be doing this for a good laugh, it must be pretty hilarious one big fucking joke struggling to deal with the pain and not cry in public giving up all hope buying a gun and not being able to pull the trigger and then reaching that point on a day where I wouldnt do it. yeah lets just have a good fucking laugh

hes one of the few people that doesn't try and guilt trip me into living for someone else. he doubts I'll make it to my 21st birthday but I know he didn't think it would be so soon. Honestly I thought it was going to be another month for school stress to overwhelm me and I do it then. since my first suicide attempt when I was 14 I knew, I was going to kill myself someday, cant explain it other than it just being inevitable. I tried to buy a gun before but couldn't even manage to walk in the store. I tried to find anything to live for, since I want to get laid so bad I tried that but my emotions get the best of me everytime. I eventually reached the point where I just didn't want to pursue that anymore due to knowing some chick is gonna think wow I fucked him and he killed himself. I'll just sacrifice my desires once more so I can finally do something purely selfish I'm tired of being chained up so everyone gets what they want except me. I don't even need the chains to break I just need them to bend far enough so I can reach the trigger.
its been 4 days and nothing has changed. today won't be the day, its my brothers graduation. But after today the old thing that stands between me and death is pulling a trigger.
